watchdog.wdo: active-low open-drain WDO, 200-ms nominal fault pulse
watchdog.firmware_service_contract: 500-ms nominal WDI cadence; each edge must arrive inside the exact TPS3435 window; malformed, early/late or missing service is a fault
watchdog.latch_behavior: WDO recovery cannot re-arm because Q remains cleared until a physical KILL-to-RUN clock

fault_record.storage: two-slot CRC-protected journal in the safety controller's 64-KB internal flash
fault_record.commit_order: write inactive slot body, verify, write commit marker, then expose to S3 read-only fault UI
fault_record.physical_recovery: acknowledged by valid KILL-to-RUN cycle; historical counter remains monotonic
fault_record.complete_aon_loss: a last-moment write is not guaranteed; next boot renders the explicit fallback 'power disappeared before diagnostics could be committed'
